assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG mobile game HOME icon, square canvas.
Input image 1 is ONLY a style and silhouette reference: a screenshot of three illustrated game buttons. Re-create ONLY its charming little house as a newly illustrated isolated object. Do not include the map or the button plate.
Primary request: a YELLOW little home icon for a warm Chinese storybook safety-education garden game called 小红花. Match the reference's hand-painted semi-realistic picture-book rendering, softly rounded toy-like forms, gently visible brush texture, warm diffuse upper-left light, crisp readable silhouette.
Subject: one adorable compact cottage in a slight three-quarter front view, large golden sunflower-yellow tiled roof and honey-yellow chimney cap, buttery cream-yellow plaster walls, recessed muted sage-green arched door with a tiny gold knob, one small glowing amber side window. The roof must clearly read as YELLOW, not orange or red. Keep the silhouette close to the house in the reference. Roof tiles are broad and simple, curved eaves, subtle depth and warm natural shading.
Composition: cottage centered and large, fills approximately 82% of square canvas, entire roof, chimney and base visible with even safety margin. Compact, uncluttered, visually legible at 64x64 pixels.
Backdrop: true transparent alpha outside the illustrated house. NO rounded square, NO cream backing plate, NO button background, NO border, NO white outline or sticker outline, NO ground platform, NO lawn, NO environment, NO cast shadow outside the house, NO checkerboard drawn into the image.
No typography, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Exactly one isolated house, not a sheet or UI mockup. Preserve soft painterly material detail, avoid flat vector or glossy plastic rendering.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG FLOWER COUNTER icon for a mobile storybook game, square canvas.
Input image 1: style and flower geometry reference only, its middle red flower is the subject to redesign without the square backing plate. Input image 2: newly approved-direction yellow house companion, match its soft painted craftsmanship, brush texture, warm left/top light and rounded volumetric shapes.
Subject: one beautiful simple five-petal RED flower facing directly forward, petals large and plump and slightly irregular like hand-painted sculpted velvet, scarlet and warm vermilion with gentle deep-red creases and highlights. Exactly five broad rounded petals surrounding one large circular warm pale-cream flower center with a subtly raised thin antique-gold rim. Keep the flower center perfectly EMPTY, smooth, light, and unobstructed so the game can later overlay a live dark-green number. The pale circular center should occupy about 43% of the whole flower diameter, comfortable for up to three number digits.
Composition: symmetrical readable silhouette, centered, flower fills about 82% of the square canvas with even clear margins, frontal camera, no stems or leaves. Match the reference flower's icon simplicity, but lovingly rendered with the same semi-realistic painterly storybook finish as the house.
Backdrop: actual transparent alpha outside the petals. NO square or rounded-square backing, NO card, NO border around the full icon, NO white sticker stroke, NO cast shadow outside the object, NO drawn checkerboard.
No digits at all, no 27, no 18, no letters, no text, no watermark. Exactly one flower, not a sheet or mockup. Avoid glossy plastic, flat vector, photorealism, excess tiny details.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone creative transparent PNG SETTINGS icon for a mobile illustrated garden safety game, square canvas.
Input image 1 is the game's current UI style reference ONLY: warmly painted rounded picture-book house, flower, trophy. Input image 2 is a companion yellow house icon: match its hand-painted gouache texture, natural soft depth, upper-left warm light and handmade craftsmanship. Do NOT copy the screenshot button backgrounds or any trophy.
Primary request: invent a charming "gardener's adjustment box" settings symbol that belongs to this little-red-flower game. It should feel like a tactile little prop from the same storybook village, clearly different in silhouette from both the home and red flower.
Subject: one compact, rounded sage-green WOODEN tool caddy/control box in very slight three-quarter front view, a short warm honey-wood carry handle behind it and just ONE small ivory rounded open-ended spanner peeking from one side. Its visible front is the physical wooden face of the object, not a separate UI button plate. On the front left is one bold golden-yellow flower-shaped ROTARY KNOB with five broad soft petals and a small leaf-green center, clearly a turnable control. On the front right are TWO very simple short vertical inset adjustment slots with chunky small warm cream/brass slider knobs at different heights. These tactile controls make it readable as "adjust settings". Keep all controls large, broad and integrated into the box, no tiny screws or fiddly decorations. The spanner is a small secondary cue, not the dominant object.
Palette: muted leaf and sage green body, warm honey wood handle, soft antique-gold flower dial, warm cream controls. Friendly and serene, no red flower on the box so it cannot be mistaken for the flower count. Semi-realistic hand-painted children's storybook icon, gently rounded proportions, matte brushy texture, warm highlights, simple readable contour.
Composition: exactly one complete small caddy with integrated controls, centered, fills approximately 80% of square canvas, even 8-10% transparent safety margin, legible at 64px.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the caddy and handle. NO enclosing square/rounded-square badge or cream plate behind it, NO outer border, NO sticker outline, NO environment, NO floor, NO drawn checkerboard, NO ambient drop shadow outside the object.
Avoid conventional gray cogwheel, mechanical gear teeth, industrial machine, basket full of tools, watering can, watering or planting symbol, trophy, text, letters, numbers, watermark, glossy 3D plastic, flat vector art.
